notes.title: Update v1.10.0 release notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/5eaa32f4c7e0815deb809cda9a6996c9507d1213.jpg
The T’au Empire joins the game tomorrow! Update v1.10.0 sets the stage for the arrival of the new faction and introduces many fixes and improvements, particularly on touch devices.

On mobile devices and Steam Deck (if ‘Touch Input’ setting is enabled), players will now be able to enlarge the cards in their hand and read their description by simply moving your finger horizontally across them, rather than having to open them one by one. To change the order of cards in your hand, they just need to drag a card slightly upwards, and then move it to the desired position.

Font sizes have also been reviewed in many places, to make sure they are easy to read on small screens. Make sure the ‘Large font size’ setting is enabled (which should happen by default on touch devices).

One other important change is the Goff offence card ‘Night Attack’, which has been reworked as it was almost never used. Its new description reads: ‘When a troop is deployed, it gets -1 Ranged Attack until its next turn’.

These changes are now live. Get ready to lead the fight for the Greater Good when the T’au Empire is released tomorrow!

notes.title: Release notes v1.7.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/2b65cfc6c0501991a7d2dba84e1c85af8ae2414d.jpg
"Activating reanimation protocol."
– Necron Technomancer

Update v1.7.0 is now live on all platforms, introducing a new feature to test your decks, quality of life improvements and a new Promo code. Take a look at the changes introduced in this update:

New features
● New ‘practice’ mode to test your decks against a bot before taking them into multiplayer. From the Decks menu in Collection, just open your deck and use the Practice button next to Edit Deck. These matches also count towards Missions!
● New custom interactions between some warlords at the start of the match. Can you find them all?
● The Cosmetics Shop has been removed from the game. We are working on other ways of obtaining them in the game. Read on to find out how to get a free avatar!

QoL improvements
● The turn timer now starts the countdown when there are 15 seconds left, instead of 10.
● Show cursor again in Steam Deck when the 'Touch Input’ toggle in Settings is disabled

Bug fixes
● The game performance has been optimised significantly, to reduce battery use and to improve the frame rate in low-spec devices.
● Improve mobile interface in battle, so that the stats of cards in hand are visible.
● Improved error handling to manage some edge cases which could leave the game on a black screen instead of showing the main menu after loading.
● Makari has been fixed, as it was not always applying his buff after being killed by Shuriken.

Avatar gift
We are giving away an amazing Avatar cosmetic to all players: the Remnant! It is a token of gratitude for your patience while we fixed the various issues on mobile, particularly the game-breaking visual problem with Remnants, and for having to update the game several times.

To get this avatar, redeem the code ‘REMNANT’ in-game or on the new website before the end of November to gain this unique cosmetic item.

As stated above, these are the changes in the latest of a long list of updates that have gone live during this week. Get a full recap of what has changed in the new web post.

Update v1.5.5 brings important usability improvements primarily for mobile devices:

 An overhaul of text and element sizes across the game should improve the readability on phone screens, which has been an overwhelming piece of feedback we have received.
 This update introduces three quality configurations, which should expand the range of supported devices. Android devices default to 'Medium' quality, but for those that were running the game without problems, we recommend switching to 'High' quality (in Settings -> Graphics) for the best visual experience.
 This version should also fix the difficulties tapping to see units in battle and clicking on some buttons and elements of the interface.
 Additionally, Burna Boy's damage has been fixed, as it was always dealing 2 damage before.


We are aware of some compatibility issues remaining on Android, particularly a serious error triggered by the Necrons’ Remnant trait. We are working hard to resolve it as soon as possible, as well as some other problems that have come up on the mobile version. You can expect further improvements and bug fixes in the next few days.

Thank you for your patience and support!

notes.title: Release notes for hotfix v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hotfix v1.0.1 has just gone live, with a couple of important fixes:
● The login/name selection popup clearly indicates now when you have already successfully logged into an existing account.
● Card texts in Polish should now be in... Polish.
● The onboarding tips have been tweaked to convey more clearly that: 
 1) you can choose any starting faction you want, not necessarily Orks,
 2) you can change your preferred faction at any time, by clicking on that faction icon in the Campaigns menu. 

Campaign Points gained from Missions go towards the faction that's selected when you claim the Mission reward. You can change from faction to faction at any time, for example to collect all the starter decks before focusing on your preferred faction.

A further update will follow up shortly with several more fixes, including an issue when collecting premium campaign rewards which can cause a server error (the reward isn't lost when the error happens, though; it can still be collected after restarting the game).

One further error we have detected is that, during the first few hours, a couple of the cards granted in the Ultramarines starter deck were incorrect. Instead of including Lieutenant Calsius and Octavio Infiltrator, everyone who collected the deck during that time received two epic cards, Company Ancient and Primaris Impulsor. Affected players may need to replace one or two cards in the deck if they appear as unavailable.

Thank you for your help reporting these errors, and for your patience while we iron them out!

notes.title: Changes since the last demo
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/37a8cbc9b98586d270b8b75ea2bb2ecd04eb7caa.jpg
"Prepare for the coming of damnation!"
– Haarken Worldclaimer

The Black Legion has started spreading the ruinous influence of the Gods of Chaos in the new Warhammer 40.000: Warpforge demo!

Besides the new Black Legion and draft mode coming into the Warpforge demo, there are also changes to the behaviour of some of the game's traits. Take a look at the complete list of changes:
● Vanguard now protects your other units from both Melee and Ranged attacks, not only from Melee ones
● Blind now reduces a unit’s Ranged Attack to zero until the end of its next turn
● Blast now deals damage to units adjacent to the target when attacking with both Melee and Ranged attacks (instead of only Ranged)
● Flying units can now be targeted by Melee attacks coming from other Flying units. They can still be attacked by Ranged attacks from both Flying and non-Flying units.
● Pin Down is no longer used. It has been replaced by Stun

notes.title: New Patch is live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470723/2b2fcf0ba652c77e981cf5ea674562f76700e69f.jpg
"Each path must be chosen with care."
– Varro Tigurius

A big patch is now live, bringing five major changes to the demo, as well as a number of small fixes:
● New languages: Players now have the option to select if they want to play in English, German, French, Spanish or Russian.
● Feedback form: An in-game form is now available for players to leave their feedback within the demo, through a button in the top right corner of the menu.
● Mac fix: This update resolves a widespread issue installing the game on Mac. Users who had this error need to uninstall the demo and install it again.
● Inbox: A messaging system is now enabled, to share important messages within the demo through an Inbox button in the top right corner of the menu.
● Visual Effects: The Unstable effect will now trigger much faster.

Ready your bolters, chainswords, sluggas and choppas! Download the new version of the demo and conquer your enemies with the greatest warriors of the Ultramarines and the biggest, choppiest boyz of the Goff Orks.
